title: Quentin and the Cipher
author: Vesper Brightwater
blurb: Yara Sandoval, a hotel concierge who notices everything, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
